ensemble.search: Six fixed compositions, K1=1/1/1 -> K2=1/8/8, T0.7; no K/anchor/temperature search
ensemble.CV: Inherited B6 grouped question splits, repeats0..9, repeat0 primary; train-only composition choice; ties prefer control, then time, then fixed order
ensemble.timing: v11 cold fixed part plus measured stage2 scaled by pending fraction and E1 K15 cost; replacing P additionally rescales its stage1 by E1 K1 rates. Other phases/lengths/batch/OOM behavior assumed unchanged; forecast only

recommendation.criterion: At least one B7 greedy heldout4k delta>=0.3pp and paired bootstrap lower>0; v11 fixed-policy replacement using that model has >= baseline old-K8 matches. No claim of statistical noninferiority.

CI: 20000 paired task multinomial bootstrap draws; seed2026102007; percentile95, pointwise descriptive; CE lacks per-example NLL
limits: B7 compact output omits step journals and model tensors; summaries/source/config/endpoints checked, no full numerical training/restore audit
